study_identification_part.si_4_title: Beyond homogeneity: charting the landscape of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric electroencephalography

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: These five datasets provided high-density EEG data for both healthy controls (reference population) and clinical groups across neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The data were aggregated from five distinct studies: the Healthy Brain Network Dataset ( HBN ) ... Multimodal Resource for Studying Information Processing in the Developing Brain ( MIPDB ) ... Autism Biomarker Consortium for Clinical Trials Dataset ( ABCCT ) ... Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD ( femaleASD ) , and Lausanne-ASD .

answer.HBN: normative training/testing; patient for clinical research (ADHD, ASD, ANX, LD)

answer.MIPDB: normative training/testing; patient for clinical research (ADHD, ASD, ANX, LD)

answer.ABCCT: normative training/testing (TD); patient for clinical research (ASD)

answer.femaleASD: normative training/testing (TD); patient for clinical research (ASD)

answer.Lausanne-ASD: normative training/testing (TD); patient for clinical research (ASD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls from all five datasets were aggregated for training (N=448) and testing (N=112) of the normative models. Patients with ADHD, ASD, ANX, and LD were used for individual deviation assessment and clinical research.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort. The clinical groups comprised 576 subjects diagnosed with ASD (52% M), 650 with ADHD (27% M), 216 with ANX (52% M), and 232 with LD (46% M).

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study developed normative models for two sets of features: spectral power and functional connectivity. Both models utilized the same pool of healthy controls (560 total, with 448 in training and 112 in test sets).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: We develop an end-to-end NM framework of a normative HD-EEG cohort comprising 560 healthy subjects (age 5-18 yo) ... Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The age range for the entire cohort was 5-18 years. The mean age of 9.99 and SD of 3.06 were reported for the total cohort of 2234 individuals. Since the controls were matched to the patients, these statistics are inferred for the HC group used in both models.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Subjects included in this study were aged between 5 and 18 years old (mean = 9.99 ± 3.06; 45% M, Fig. S1).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Training HC (n=448) was 52% male. Held-out test HC (n=112) was 55% male. Sex counts for the overall phase (N=560) were inferred by summing the counts from training (approx. 233 male, 215 female) and test (approx. 62 male, 50 female) sets.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort.
